theorem weighted_adjacent_identity
    (a : Nat -> Real) (lam Z : Real)
    (hLam : lam ≠ 0) (hZ : Z ≠ 0) (n : Nat) :
    (lam + lam⁻¹) * (a (n + 1) * lam ^ (n + 1) / Z)
      - (a n * lam ^ n / Z)
      - (a (n + 2) * lam ^ (n + 2) / Z) =
    (lam ^ n / Z) *
      ((a (n + 1) - a n) + lam ^ 2 * (a (n + 1) - a (n + 2)))
informal_statement: For every sequence a:Nat->Real, all nonzero real lam and Z, and every n:Nat, (lam + lam^(-1))*(a(n+1)*lam^(n+1)/Z) - a(n)*lam^n/Z - a(n+2)*lam^(n+2)/Z = (lam^n/Z)*((a(n+1)-a(n)) + lam^2*(a(n+1)-a(n+2))). This is a scalar equality only; it asserts no forest positivity, mean-centering, recursive preservation, or unimodality.
